summary: Complete, standalone single-file HTML/JS web application for 'Packing Material & Thermocol' connected directly to Firebase Firestore (ich-indore-v3). Includes complete Firebase v10 SDK integration, real-time onSnapshot listeners for packing_inwards, packing_outwards, packing_master, and packing_audits, addDoc/setDoc persistence, AIL/AHPL multi-division queues, custom sequence reset, FIFO stock calculation, printable GST tax invoices, and 239-column SAP IRN CSV export.
